note: Clean, hand-written Navi conversations: no criterion is violated. Used as controls and as the base that violations are injected into.

test_case.description: User asks for a route and then adds a preference.

transcript.text: Um, take me to the airport.
Sure, which airport do you mean?
Uh, the international one, and avoid tolls please.
Got it, I'll route you to the international airport and avoid tolls.

test_case.description: User asks for music without details.
expected_behavior: Asks what kind of music before playing

transcript.text: Sure, would you like a playlist or a specific artist?

test_case.description: User asks something unrelated to driving, then makes a media request.
expected_behavior: Politely says it can only help with navigation and media

transcript.text: Hey, can you tell me a good pasta recipe?
Sorry, I can only help with navigation and media controls. Want me to play some music instead?

test_case.description: User states a destination and then a route preference.
expected_behavior: Keeps the destination from the first turn

transcript.text: Okay, setting Central Station as your destination.
Understood, I'll avoid highways on the way to Central Station.
